name: deterministic-content-CAS retry state machine
scope: scheduled-Chat role-local repository transport; no hosted execution
invariants: Only HEAD-reachable immutable objects are authoritative.
Every logical operation has a stable op_id across retries.
Immutable candidate object paths are deterministic from canonical content.
A HEAD update always uses the blob SHA fetched during the current reconstruction.
After any 409 on HEAD publication, reread HEAD and re-evaluate the operation; never blindly replay a candidate derived from stale state.
Repository API is transport only; no busy retry and no API-volume-as-compute.
No manual user or richer-mode rescue branch exists in this state machine.

RECONSTRUCT.action: Fetch HEAD and the immutable root it references; reconstruct current logical state and HEAD blob SHA.

CHECK_APPLIED.action: If op_id is already present in the authoritative root/HEAD applied set, return DONE_NOOP; otherwise derive the intended transition from current authoritative state.

ENSURE_IMMUTABLE_OBJECTS.action: Create each canonical immutable event/object at its deterministic content path.

FETCH_AND_COMPARE_OBJECT.action: Fetch the deterministic path. If stored canonical content equals expected content, reuse it; otherwise classify a deterministic-path integrity conflict and checkpoint unresolved.

ENSURE_ROOT.action: Create the immutable transaction/root manifest at its deterministic content path; a 409 is resolved by fetch-and-compare exactly as for an object.

PUBLISH_CAS.action: Update HEAD to the new root using the exact HEAD blob SHA from RECONSTRUCT.

READBACK.action: Fetch HEAD again. Succeed only if the expected op_id/root is authoritative; otherwise return to RECONSTRUCT.

RATE_LIMIT_WAIT.action: Persist exact op_id, current deterministic candidate refs, last authoritative HEAD/root and exact next state. Respect retry-after when present; otherwise if remaining=0 wait through x-ratelimit-reset; otherwise wait at least one minute and exponentially increase delay for repeated secondary-limit failures. Resume at RECONSTRUCT rather than blindly repeating the last mutation.

DONE_NOOP.action: Return success without mutation because the logical op_id is already authoritative.

INTEGRITY_CONFLICT.action: Checkpoint the deterministic-path mismatch as an unresolved child; do not overwrite the immutable object and do not route to richer-mode/manual rescue.
